post.description:
This API provides a Summary of Notification Record Types.

Request Information:

recordType: Valid Record Types are Admission, Discharge, Emergency, Referrals.

fromDate: This field should be allowed only for Referrals record type. Max date range is 90 days up to one year in the past.

toDate: This field should allowed only for Referrals record type. Max date range is 90 days up to one year in the past.

Record Type

Default Date Range

Allowed Date Range

Admission

7 Days

N/A

Discharge

7 Days

N/A

Emergency

7 Days

N/A

Referrals

14 Days for Expiring referrals and 90 days for All Referrals

Allowed only for All Referrals. Max date range is 90 days up to one year in past

Response Information:

Returns the count of record statuses for each record type.

parameters.description: Facility/Tax Identification Number used in the request

Dates must be in ISO format (yyyy-MM-dd) || TMT_INV_DT_FDGTD: fromDate cannot be after toDate || TMT_INV_DT_FDT: Dates cannot be in the future || TMT_INV_DT_OR: Dates must be within one year from the current date || TITAS113: ClientID is missing or empty. || TMT_NA_DT_RANGE: Date range is not allowed for record types Admission, Discharge, Emergency. || TITAS101: Provider TIN is required.

This API provides a summary of the claims with the count of all the statuses.

recordType: Valid Record Types are RECON, PENDED, PENDINGCLAIMS and DOCUMENTATIONEDITS.

recordStatusList: Valid statuses for different Record Types are shown below.

fromDate: Valid Date format is YYYY-MM-DD

toDate: Valid Date format is YYYY-MM-DD

Record Type

Allowed Record Status

Allowed Date Range

Default Date Range

Max date range is 90 days up to one year in the past

14 Days

PENDED

Requires Attention, Under Review, Recently Closed

Max date range is 90 days up to one year in the past

14 Days

Action Required, Retry Document

N/A

N/A

Returns the count of record statuses for each record type.

Note: For PENDINGCLAIMS & DOCUMENTATIONEDITS record type(s), the record statuses Action Required, Retry Document are shown in the response.
